parent_objective: audit whether the M974 exact-repaired candidate should replace alpha_1_0 as the current public-gate base
blocked_by: M976 classifies the exact-repaired candidate as a full public-gate candidate but promotion has not been audited
invalidates: using M974 exact-repaired candidate as public-gate base without promotion audit

public_gates: M977 must not use private holdout
M977 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M977 must verify M974 exact/first-replay pass
M977 must verify M976 full public proof/generalization/behavior pass
M977 must explicitly decide whether to update the public-gate base
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim paper-level or real-vehicle validation
do not promote without recording caveats

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_promotion: public-base promotion decision after exact repair and full gate
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether the exact-repaired M974 candidate can replace alpha_1_0 as current public-gate base
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public-gate base promotion audit only; no PPO, no private holdout, no paper-level or real-vehicle claim
stop_condition: stop if M974 exact/first-replay evidence is missing or failed
stop if M976 full public gate evidence is missing or failed
stop if promotion caveats are not recorded
fallback_plan: if audit passes, promote M974 candidate as the public-gate base and route to post-promotion synthesis
if audit fails, route to proof/generalization/behavior audit matching the failed evidence
if evidence is incomplete, route to evidence-completion gate
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M976 classifies the exact-repaired candidate as a full public-gate candidate

hypothesis: The M974 exact-repaired candidate has enough public proof, fresh generalization, and behavior evidence to be promoted as the new public-gate base while keeping PPO, private-holdout, paper-level, and real-vehicle claims blocked.
success_criteria: M974 exact and first-replay evidence is cited
M976 full public gate evidence is cited
promotion or rejection decision is explicit
current-status public-gate base is updated if promoted
PPO and private holdout remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit promotes without checking M974 and M976 evidence

commands.name: write_promotion_audit
commands.command: write docs/m977-v4-public-base-post-promotion-exact-repair-promotion-audit.md and update current public-gate base only if audit passes

decision_rule: M977 may only audit promotion. It must not update actor parameters, run PPO, change actor inputs, use private holdout, or claim paper-level generalization.
